mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.leader_skill_master ( leader_skill_id, attribute, amount, area, element, swarfarm_url, icon_path, last_sync_date, crt_user_id, crt_date, upt_user_id, upt_date ) VALUES ( #{leader_skill_id}, #{attribute}, #{amount}, #{area}, #{element}, #{swarfarm_url}, #{icon_path}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (leader_skill_id) DO UPDATE SET attribute = EXCLUDED.attribute, amount = EXCLUDED.amount, area = EXCLUDED.area, element = EXCLUDED.element, swarfarm_url = EXCLUDED.swarfarm_url, icon_path = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.icon_path, leader_skill_master.icon_path), last_sync_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, upt_user_id = 'SYSTEM', upt_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO public.monster_leaders ( leader_id, type, stat, increase_by, icon_path, crt_user_id, crt_date, upt_user_id, upt_date ) VALUES ( #{leader_id}, #{type}, #{stat}, #{increase_by}, #{icon_path}, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (leader_id) DO UPDATE SET type = EXCLUDED.type, stat = EXCLUDED.stat, increase_by = EXCLUDED.increase_by, icon_path = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.icon_path, monster_leaders.icon_path), upt_user_id = 'SYSTEM', upt_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
